profile.headline: Software Engineering Team Lead | Platform & Backend | Production AI and Agentic Systems | Go, Python, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure, AWS
profile.summary:
I build and lead platform engineering teams. Today I lead a platform team as its delivery owner and primary technical decision-maker, and I stay hands-on in the code.
Most of my work is backend and cloud-native: distributed, event-driven services, the pipelines that move data between them, and the infrastructure they run on. I design the service boundaries and messaging patterns, write the infrastructure and the pipelines that deploy it, and own access control and secrets in PCI-compliant environments. I work across Python, Go, and TypeScript, and in Node.js, Java, C++, and C# where the system calls for it.
The work I find most interesting right now is production AI. Not prompting, but systems where a model is the decision engine over non-deterministic input and then takes consequential action through tools I expose to it. I have built an agentic payment system that analyzes time-sensitive payments, determines the best route to pay them, and executes through tool calls into downstream platforms, and a real-time phone payment system with an LLM at its center. I write the tool-call contracts myself, and I build the regression testing that keeps non-deterministic systems honest.
Leading a team, for me, is mostly negotiation and ownership: roadmap, sequencing, and resourcing with product; service boundaries and technology choices with architecture; and being the person who runs an incident to ground when it spans several teams.
Before software I spent six years in aerospace, leading FAA airworthiness certification data packages for aircraft and rotorcraft. That work was about assembling the evidence a regulator requires before a safety-critical system is allowed to carry people, and it still shapes how I think about correctness, review, and shipping things others depend on.
I hold a B.S. in Computer Science from Oregon State University and a B.S. in Biological Engineering from the University of Missouri.

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
Engineering leader and hands-on builder, leading a platform team as its delivery owner and primary technical decision-maker.

LEADERSHIP • Own sprint planning, work allocation, and roadmap communication • Negotiate roadmap, sequencing, and resourcing with product • Negotiate service boundaries and technology choices with architecture • Escalation point for incidents spanning multiple engineering teams, isolating where the process failed and driving resolution • Partner with product managers across the identity, fraud, KYC/KYB, and banking platforms we depend on • Mentor engineers on backend, DevOps, and cloud-native practice

PLATFORM & BACKEND • Own the technical direction of a customer onboarding platform across multiple products • Built the company's first public API for headless, self-service onboarding • Build distributed, event-driven services and pipelines moving data between internal systems and partners • Work in the Angular and React front ends my team owns

AI SYSTEMS • Built an agentic payment system that analyzes payments, determines the best route to pay them, and executes via tool calls downstream • Built a production AI system handling inbound phone payments in real time, with an LLM as the decision engine • Write the tool-call contracts exposed to models, not framework integrations • Build regression testing for non-deterministic AI systems

PAYMENTS & LENDING • Led an invoice financing platform build, from eligibility decisions to payment orchestration • Led the company credit card product, orchestrating payments and lending with card and banking partners • Built bank integrations and NACHA payment file generation

INFRASTRUCTURE & DEVOPS • Wrote pipeline and infrastructure templates now standard across most engineering teams • Led Kubernetes adoption and scaling strategy • Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and release strategy • Own access control and secrets in PCI-compliant environments

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend and platform engineer on the cloud platform, working in Go and C++.

BACKEND & DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS • Built Go microservices processing hundreds of gigabytes of data through a proprietary C++ analytics engine • Marshaled data across C APIs and returned results over gRPC, solving Go and C memory-model conversions at high throughput • Built the distributed cloud services that brought a desktop analytics product to the cloud • Handled streaming ingest of customer data through the system • Built licensing and product-key services handling activation for thousands of desktop installations

ANALYTICS ENGINE • Core maintainer of the C++ analytics engine, working across its data structures, caching, and build and dependency management • Integrated the C++ analytics engine of an acquired company, which spoke a substantially different DSL, into our own • Compiled the engine to WebAssembly for in-browser analytics • Built a TypeScript harness for contract-testing WASM binaries

CLOUD & DELIVERY • Deployed services to Kubernetes on AWS using Docker, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer splitting time roughly evenly between two teams: scientific simulation and new product development.

ENERGY SIMULATION • Developed new algorithms and resolved defects in open-source engines modeling building physics, HVAC components, and electricity distribution systems • Contributed to the National Renewable Energy Laboratory's EnergyPlus engine and the California Simulation Engine • Wrote Python and C++ that remains in production use today, in open-source libraries for grid interpolation and ASHRAE Standard 205 equipment data • Worked in large production codebases with unit test coverage

NEW PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT • Built web applications full-stack for new services, from the React front end through the C# backend and the database behind it

positions.title: Full Stack Application Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer across the company's financial analytics SaaS applications.

• Built back-end functionality for a custom R language infrastructure served over Apache • Parallelized runtime-critical predictive modeling with multithreading • Built the front ends over those features • Maintained cloud infrastructure on AWS and administered Linux development machines

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer
positions.description:
Mechanical design and certification engineer for aircraft and rotorcraft modifications.

• Led FAA airworthiness certification data packages, including DER 8110 field approvals and Supplemental Type Certificates for Part 23 and Part 25 aircraft and rotorcraft • Produced over 100 engineering drawing and analysis packages • Owned structural analysis, including finite element analysis and some computational fluid dynamics, and the design work behind it • Project manager on large-scale certification efforts, coordinating engineering support, customers, and vendors to deadline 

• Coordinated with aircraft operators, maintenance and repair organizations, and FAA designated engineering representatives • Guided maintenance facilities performing modifications within applicable FAA regulations
